name: Peking University (School of Mathematical Sciences / BICMR)
header:
Peking University (School of Mathematical
Sciences / BICMR)
China · English-taught mathematics PhD (direct bachelor's route); Chinese-taught pure mathematics master's; separate
Chinese-national overseas-bachelor's PhD route
Selected Asia programme; no ranking cutoff implied.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• International and Chinese-national routes have materially different eligibility, fee, portal, score policy and
document deadlines.
• International application 25 December 2026; recommendations 31 December 2026; original pre-admission
packet 31 May 2027.
• No verified 2027 scholarship closing date; monitor from January rather than relying on FAQ's March/April
wording.
• BICMR's RMB 160,000-200,000 annual package is a prior-cycle total including CSC, not a verified cash
stipend.
• The completed faculty audit is incorporated below, including 29 individually sourced entries and three
additional contacts with explicitly incomplete recent-paper or supervision evidence.
• The faculty list is a research-fit map. Current appointments and paper evidence do not establish 2027
supervision capacity or permission to enter a particular admissions route.
• BICMR and the School of Mathematical Sciences have overlapping rosters; faculty are deduplicated. Old
English directory research labels can be wrong (notably Qi'an Guan). Current author profiles and papers take
priority.
• Dates below distinguish publication years from preprint or revision dates; an undated forthcoming article is
not assigned a guessed publication year.
• Bin Zhou is another directory mismatch: the current author page and 2026 paper establish geometric
analysis/complex Monge-Ampère work, while an English faculty list uses a
low-dimensional-topology/representation label.
• Hanlong Fang and Zhiqiang Li explicitly invite prospective graduate contact on their author pages; no
invitation should be treated as an admission or funding promise.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
International route: a bachelor's holder may apply directly to science PhD programmes; the current
mathematics catalogue includes English-taught pure mathematics. A UChicago mathematics degree is
academically appropriate, subject to qualification assessment and completion before September 2027
registration. Applicant must qualify as non-Chinese; former mainland/Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan residents need
qualifying foreign nationality documents issued before 30 April 2021 plus evidence of Chinese-nationality
cancellation. The statement template excludes holders of Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan resident identity cards
from this international route. F-1 status does not resolve citizenship. Alternative if Chinese: 2027 Math/BICMR
accepts overseas bachelor's graduates from School-recognized world-class universities with GPA above 3.5/4.0
or top-50% class standing. Chinese-taught master's is also listed, with HSK requirements. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s7] [s8]

Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose the correct nationality route and specific research field. Arrange official transcripts,
expected-graduation proof, passport history, signed templates and two senior academic referees. Graduates
need CSCSE degree authentication when applying; final-year students may defer it until enrolment. Obtain
approval before treating UChicago English-medium study as alternative English evidence. International
admission is followed by academic screening and a second examination/interview January-March 2027; exact
mathematics arrangements are not yet published. Plan a separate scholarship application and later
paper-document delivery. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s7]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
The current English-taught catalogue includes algebraic geometry, arithmetic geometry/p-adic cohomology,
Langlands, representation theory, complex geometry, birational geometry and mirror symmetry. Contact a
relevant active supervisor to establish fit and capacity. No universal prior-supervisor-acceptance requirement
was identified for international admission; scholarship research-plan signature can make contact necessary
later. Admissions contacts: phdprogram@bicmr.pku.edu.cn and zixun@math.pku.edu.cn. [s4] [s6] [s7] [s15]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
International application: https://www.studyatpku.com; current public FAQ documents Send Email,
reminder/replacement before submission and completion timestamps. Academic and scholarship forms are
separate. Chinese-national route: https://admission.pku.edu.cn/applications/ plus the departmental email
packet. No account was created or invitation sent during research. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7] [s10]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Central international guide, FAQs, English PhD/master's catalogues and domestic Math/BICMR guide explicitly
cover 2027. BICMR programme guide and latest detailed scholarship call remain 2026; their funding
amounts/interview precedents are labelled accordingly. No invented 2027 scholarship date. International 2027
fee/tuition/English policy cannot be silently replaced by domestic or older pages. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s7] [s10]

Academic application [2027 confirmed]
International 2027 entry: 26 October-25 December 2026, Beijing time; exact closing hour is not published in
the central international guide. Do not import the Chinese-national route's 17:00 clock. Chinese-national

document deadline below. BICMR's 23 December 2025 page concerns the previous cycle. [s1] [s6] [s7]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
English-taught international PhD: central 2027 guide accepts TOEFL iBT 5.0+, or old-scale 100+ for tests
between 1 September 2025 and 21 January 2026; GRE above 315 or other English-proficiency evidence is also
listed, subject to programme requirements. BICMR's prior-cycle guide says TOEFL 100 or GRE 315+ or other
certificates. Chinese-taught science master's: HSK 6 above 200, writing at least 65; qualifying HSK 7-9
accepted. IELTS mathematics threshold not publicly specified. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
International mathematics: no explicit automatic English-medium-degree exemption found. UChicago
transcript/degree and institutional medium-of-instruction letter are plausible 'other evidence', but need
BICMR/School approval. Do not import the business school's waiver. Chinese-national route explicitly accepts
an English-taught degree earned in an English-speaking country/region after 1 September 2015; a completed
UChicago degree fits that alternative (inference), while final-year timing needs confirmation. [s1] [s6] [s7]
GRE General [Conflict]
Not established as an independent academic-admission requirement. International English-taught route
permits GRE as one English-evidence alternative: current guide says above 315; older BICMR page says 315 or
above. Resolve the boundary if using 315. Chinese-national route accepts GRE 300+ taken after 1 September
2022 as one of several English alternatives; completed English-medium degree can replace it. [s1] [s6] [s7]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No Mathematics Subject GRE requirement or recommendation found in the reviewed international or
Chinese-national mathematics admission documents. Optional submission/consideration is unverified; absence
from the checklist is not a promise that it is disregarded. [s1] [s6] [s7]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
Two professors/associate professors in the relevant subject, or professionals of equivalent relevant academic
rank. Chinese or English accepted. For a UChicago undergraduate, choose senior faculty who know the
academic work; a graduate-student TA alone does not satisfy the stated rank rule. Chinese-national route
likewise requires two associate-professor-equivalent or higher experts. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Scholarship references [Prior cycle]
The previous Type B CSC checklist requires two professor/associate-professor letters with scholarship-oriented
content: objectives for study in China, overall ability/potential, and institutional or supervisor cooperation
where relevant. No evidence that a third referee is required. Automatic reuse from admission, a fresh
invitation, and 2027 changes remain unverified. PKU's separate scholarship form and CSC form are distinct
submissions. [s10] [s15]
What sends the invitation [2027 confirmed]
International portal sends the invitation when the applicant enters the email and clicks Send Email; entering
details alone is not the documented trigger. Referee follows the link and either completes the form or uploads
a signed-letter scan. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Before versus after submission [2027 confirmed]
Invitations can be sent before final submission; the FAQ explicitly permits resending/changing referee
information before submitting the application. They do not have to wait until after submission. [s2] [s3]
Receipt confirmation [2027 confirmed]
The portal displays the reference completion timestamp: populated Time of Submission/Reply Time means
submitted; blank means not received. A resend invalidates the prior link. Avoid repeated resend clicks within a
short period. [s2] [s3]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Before application submission, referee identity/email can be changed and a new invitation sent; previous links
expire. Public FAQ does not establish replacement of the contents of an already accepted report,
post-submission referee changes, cross-programme reuse or next-cycle reuse. Chinese-national route
additionally requires sealed signed paper letters at interview verification; international route does not mail
letters. [s2] [s3] [s7]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [2027 confirmed]
Résumé required; no mandatory template or public page/word limit. Upload initially; if pre-admitted, include a
double-sided printed copy in the 31 May packet. No general requirement for a CV photograph was verified for
mathematics. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Statement of purpose [2027 confirmed]
International statement is called Personal Statement and incorporates the research plan; no second separately
named SOP identified. Use the official template, approximately 3000 English words for BICMR PhD according to

its prior-cycle programme guide, aligned with central 2027's 3000-word specification. Master's central target
1500 words. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Personal / background statement [2027 confirmed]
Required official template: explain academic preparation, work/research experience and results, proposed
research, and future professional intentions (paraphrase). Include applicant name, department and major;
answer the mandatory Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan identity-card declaration; sign and date by hand using
passport name (Chinese FAQ also requests Chinese name if any). Central guide specifies 3000 words PhD/1500
master's, without explicitly calling it a maximum. No font/margin rule found. Double-sided paper copy is later
required. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s8]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Integrated into the personal statement/research plan and selected catalogue research field. No additional
independent research-interest essay or separate length limit found. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Research proposal [2027 confirmed]
Research plan is part of the 3000-word PhD personal statement; the template requests a developed proposal.
No separately mandated ordinary-admission proposal upload found. CSC scholarship has a separate plan
requirement in the previous-year checklist; see scholarship writing. [s1] [s8] [s15]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
International admission does not require a thesis or standalone writing sample in the reviewed guide; original
research achievements may be included voluntarily. FAQ advises publication citations and abstracts because
of upload limits, rather than automatically uploading whole papers. Chinese-national standard doctoral
checklist includes master's thesis or, for current master's students, abstract/contents; direct bachelor's
applicants must clarify inapplicability. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Optional citation/table-of-contents information and abstracts of published academic work or other original
achievements. Publications are not compulsory. The precise per-file size and whether links may substitute are
not public; use the upload instructions. Chinese-national route accepts published/accepted papers and requires
a supervisor-signed/institution-stamped acceptance letter for accepted unpublished work. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No standalone course-list essay/template identified beyond official transcript. Course descriptions are likewise
not a universal initial writing task. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship essays [Prior cycle]
2027 scholarship prompts not yet released. PRECEDENT:2026 CSC Type B checklist calls for a Chinese/English
study plan exceeding 1000 words/characters and, for PhD, the Chinese supervisor's signature; two scholarship
letters; pre-admission evidence; diploma/transcripts; language proof; physical-exam form and
noncriminal-record evidence, normally within 6 months. PKU's 2026 call allowed signed
physical-exam/no-record declarations where items were inapplicable. Do not substitute an embassy Type A
800-word plan for this Type B requirement. Current-year template and exact exceptions need rechecking. [s10]
[s15] [s16]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
Application Commitment letter is mandatory, printed and signed with a pen then scanned; electronic signature
is not accepted. Obtain current template from the official downloads page, because an accessible
business-school mirror is explicitly for 2026. International 2026 pure-math interview precedent:10-minute

deadline unannounced. Chinese-national packet:one ordered PDF≤15 MB excluding letters, named

staples/binding/cover and held by a binder clip. [s2] [s3] [s7] [s9] [s17] [s20]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
2027 university-specific living stipend is not published in the checked international guide. BICMR's 2026-cycle
page quotes total package RMB 160,000-200,000/year INCLUDING CSC; it does not identify cash stipend versus
tuition/housing components and is not a 2027 guarantee. General 2027-28 full CSC standard, corroborated by
a Chinese embassy: doctoral living stipend RMB 3,500/month=42,000/year, master's
3,000/month=36,000/year, plus tuition, housing/subsidy and medical insurance. Whether the applicant's PKU
award adopts this standard must be confirmed. PKU scholarship amount and Beijing A stipend amount not
found. Current 2027 science tuition table says pending approval; do not carry forward old approximate
40,000/year. [s1] [s6] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s16]
Years of support [Standing rule]
International bachelor's-entry PhD normally 5 years; master's-entry 4 years. Standing CSC award supports 4-5
years and annual review. PKU scholarship standing page says 4 years PhD, creating a potential fifth-year gap
for direct entrants. Beijing Government Scholarship for new students follows standard programme duration;
current-student awards last one year. BICMR's 2027 package duration/guarantee is not verified. [s1] [s6] [s11]
[s12] [s13]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
The listed CSC, PKU and Beijing awards are expressly for eligible international students. Initial application is
labelled self-funded even when subsequently seeking scholarships. Admission does not itself guarantee an
award. Chinese-national applicants use a different domestic funding system; international scholarships cannot
be assumed. CSC general degree/age rules and direct-bachelor exception for PKU need confirmation;
Tsinghua's explicit exception cannot be transferred to PKU. [s1] [s10] [s11] [s12] [s13] [s16]
Conditions and duties [Conflict]
Awards require annual review; restrictions on concurrent scholarships apply (some one-time merit awards
excepted). PKU/CSC calls exclude joint-training candidates in the reviewed prior-cycle notice. Beijing
scholarship doctoral age limit 40 at entry and ordinary-tuition-programme condition apply. BICMR page's
CSC-housing language conflicts with its quoted discounted 130 RMB/day room rate; resolve housing coverage
in the written offer. TA/RA duties, net living allowance, taxes, insurance beyond awarded coverage and
fifth-year terms are not publicly quantified. [s6] [s10] [s11] [s12] [s13]
Extra funding application [Prior cycle]
Yes: scholarship application is separate from academic admission. Standing CSC process requires both PKU and
CSC submissions. In 2026 a single PKU scholarship form covered CSC/PKUS/Beijing consideration, but CSC
additionally required its own application, Type B institution code 10001, and specific pre-admission certificate.
Only one final scholarship was awarded.2027 form-opening dates/workflow must be confirmed. [s10] [s11] [s12]
[s13]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Embassy/dispatching-agency CSC Type A is a separate possible route, with nationality-specific deadlines.
BICMR institutional scholarship may supplement CSC within the stated total package; do not add the full
package and CSC twice. Continuing-student donation/merit awards appear in the official directory but are not
guaranteed initial funding. Chinese-national branch needs the domestic 2027 funding offer separately. [s6] [s16]
[s18]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
International: RMB 800 per major/programme, nonrefundable; online payment by 25 December 2026. Up to
two university applications may be possible, each paid separately, but older BICMR instructions limit its
applicant to one major; verify programme restriction. Chinese-national Math/BICMR: RMB 200, one choice, paid
by 25 December 2026 17:00. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s7]

Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No ordinary mathematics international fee-waiver or hardship procedure found in the reviewed official
guide/FAQ/search. Scholarship application does not establish an admission-fee waiver. Ask study@pku.edu.cn
or phdprogram@bicmr.pku.edu.cn before paying if a waiver is essential. [s1] [s2] [s6]

Pay attention to
• International and Chinese-national routes have materially different eligibility, fee, portal, score policy and
document deadlines.
• International application 25 December 2026; recommendations 31 December 2026; original pre-admission
packet 31 May 2027.
• No verified 2027 scholarship closing date; monitor from January rather than relying on FAQ's March/April
wording.
• BICMR's RMB 160,000-200,000 annual package is a prior-cycle total including CSC, not a verified cash
stipend.
• The completed faculty audit is incorporated below, including 29 individually sourced entries and three
additional contacts with explicitly incomplete recent-paper or supervision evidence.
• The faculty list is a research-fit map. Current appointments and paper evidence do not establish 2027
supervision capacity or permission to enter a particular admissions route.
• BICMR and the School of Mathematical Sciences have overlapping rosters; faculty are deduplicated. Old
English directory research labels can be wrong (notably Qi'an Guan). Current author profiles and papers take
priority.
• Dates below distinguish publication years from preprint or revision dates; an undated forthcoming article is
not assigned a guessed publication year.
• Bin Zhou is another directory mismatch: the current author page and 2026 paper establish geometric
analysis/complex Monge-Ampère work, while an English faculty list uses a
low-dimensional-topology/representation label.
• Hanlong Fang and Zhiqiang Li explicitly invite prospective graduate contact on their author pages; no
invitation should be treated as an admission or funding promise.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
International route: a bachelor's holder may apply directly to science PhD programmes; the current
mathematics catalogue includes English-taught pure mathematics. A UChicago mathematics degree is
academically appropriate, subject to qualification assessment and completion before September 2027
registration. Applicant must qualify as non-Chinese; former mainland/Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan residents need
qualifying foreign nationality documents issued before 30 April 2021 plus evidence of Chinese-nationality
cancellation. The statement template excludes holders of Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan resident identity cards
from this international route. F-1 status does not resolve citizenship. Alternative if Chinese: 2027 Math/BICMR
accepts overseas bachelor's graduates from School-recognized world-class universities with GPA above 3.5/4.0
or top-50% class standing. Chinese-taught master's is also listed, with HSK requirements. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s7] [s8]

Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose the correct nationality route and specific research field. Arrange official transcripts,
expected-graduation proof, passport history, signed templates and two senior academic referees. Graduates
need CSCSE degree authentication when applying; final-year students may defer it until enrolment. Obtain
approval before treating UChicago English-medium study as alternative English evidence. International
admission is followed by academic screening and a second examination/interview January-March 2027; exact
mathematics arrangements are not yet published. Plan a separate scholarship application and later
paper-document delivery. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s7]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
The current English-taught catalogue includes algebraic geometry, arithmetic geometry/p-adic cohomology,
Langlands, representation theory, complex geometry, birational geometry and mirror symmetry. Contact a
relevant active supervisor to establish fit and capacity. No universal prior-supervisor-acceptance requirement
was identified for international admission; scholarship research-plan signature can make contact necessary
later. Admissions contacts: phdprogram@bicmr.pku.edu.cn and zixun@math.pku.edu.cn. [s4] [s6] [s7] [s15]

International application: https://www.studyatpku.com; current public FAQ documents Send Email,
reminder/replacement before submission and completion timestamps. Academic and scholarship forms are
separate. Chinese-national route: https://admission.pku.edu.cn/applications/ plus the departmental email
packet. No account was created or invitation sent during research. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7] [s10]

International uploads/payment due 25 December 2026; referees/HSK exceptions above. Pre-admitted

Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal offer-acceptance deadline verified. Preliminary admission is expected before end-May; formal
international admission documents are issued in batches from late June 2027; registration is early September
on the letter's date. The 31 May paper-packet deadline is a compliance stage, not a stated final commitment
deadline. Confirm the offer-specific response and funding acceptance dates. [s1] [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
English-taught international PhD: central 2027 guide accepts TOEFL iBT 5.0+, or old-scale 100+ for tests
between 1 September 2025 and 21 January 2026; GRE above 315 or other English-proficiency evidence is also
listed, subject to programme requirements. BICMR's prior-cycle guide says TOEFL 100 or GRE 315+ or other
certificates. Chinese-taught science master's: HSK 6 above 200, writing at least 65; qualifying HSK 7-9
accepted. IELTS mathematics threshold not publicly specified. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
International mathematics: no explicit automatic English-medium-degree exemption found. UChicago
transcript/degree and institutional medium-of-instruction letter are plausible 'other evidence', but need
BICMR/School approval. Do not import the business school's waiver. Chinese-national route explicitly accepts
an English-taught degree earned in an English-speaking country/region after 1 September 2015; a completed
UChicago degree fits that alternative (inference), while final-year timing needs confirmation. [s1] [s6] [s7]
GRE General [Conflict]
Not established as an independent academic-admission requirement. International English-taught route
permits GRE as one English-evidence alternative: current guide says above 315; older BICMR page says 315 or
above. Resolve the boundary if using 315. Chinese-national route accepts GRE 300+ taken after 1 September
2022 as one of several English alternatives; completed English-medium degree can replace it. [s1] [s6] [s7]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]

Chinese-national mathematics admission documents. Optional submission/consideration is unverified; absence
from the checklist is not a promise that it is disregarded. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [2027 confirmed]
International: official transcripts with every course, grade and grading scale; originals/notarized copies scanned
in colour with a scanner, not phone photographs. FAQ rejects transcripts marked unofficial or copy. Upload
degree/graduation certificates and CSCSE authentication if already graduated; current students supply official
expected-graduation date and current transcript, then final records before enrolment. Submit passport bio
pages covering all ordinary passports continuously since 30 April 2021; current passport valid≥3 months
beyond enrolment. Chinese-national route additionally specifies national ID, its application form, original
academic records and degree/authentication documents; qualifying overseas bachelor's applicants should
confirm which master's-labelled items are inapplicable. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
Two professors/associate professors in the relevant subject, or professionals of equivalent relevant academic
rank. Chinese or English accepted. For a UChicago undergraduate, choose senior faculty who know the
academic work; a graduate-student TA alone does not satisfy the stated rank rule. Chinese-national route
likewise requires two associate-professor-equivalent or higher experts. [s1] [s6] [s7]
Scholarship references [Prior cycle]
The previous Type B CSC checklist requires two professor/associate-professor letters with scholarship-oriented
content: objectives for study in China, overall ability/potential, and institutional or supervisor cooperation
where relevant. No evidence that a third referee is required. Automatic reuse from admission, a fresh
invitation, and 2027 changes remain unverified. PKU's separate scholarship form and CSC form are distinct
submissions. [s10] [s15]
What sends the invitation [2027 confirmed]
International portal sends the invitation when the applicant enters the email and clicks Send Email; entering
details alone is not the documented trigger. Referee follows the link and either completes the form or uploads
a signed-letter scan. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Before versus after submission [2027 confirmed]
Invitations can be sent before final submission; the FAQ explicitly permits resending/changing referee
information before submitting the application. They do not have to wait until after submission. [s2] [s3]
Receipt confirmation [2027 confirmed]
The portal displays the reference completion timestamp: populated Time of Submission/Reply Time means
submitted; blank means not received. A resend invalidates the prior link. Avoid repeated resend clicks within a
short period. [s2] [s3]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Before application submission, referee identity/email can be changed and a new invitation sent; previous links
expire. Public FAQ does not establish replacement of the contents of an already accepted report,
post-submission referee changes, cross-programme reuse or next-cycle reuse. Chinese-national route
additionally requires sealed signed paper letters at interview verification; international route does not mail
letters. [s2] [s3] [s7]

independent research-interest essay or separate length limit found. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Research proposal [2027 confirmed]
Research plan is part of the 3000-word PhD personal statement; the template requests a developed proposal.
No separately mandated ordinary-admission proposal upload found. CSC scholarship has a separate plan

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
International admission does not require a thesis or standalone writing sample in the reviewed guide; original
research achievements may be included voluntarily. FAQ advises publication citations and abstracts because
of upload limits, rather than automatically uploading whole papers. Chinese-national standard doctoral
checklist includes master's thesis or, for current master's students, abstract/contents; direct bachelor's
applicants must clarify inapplicability. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Optional citation/table-of-contents information and abstracts of published academic work or other original
achievements. Publications are not compulsory. The precise per-file size and whether links may substitute are
not public; use the upload instructions. Chinese-national route accepts published/accepted papers and requires
a supervisor-signed/institution-stamped acceptance letter for accepted unpublished work. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s7]

not a universal initial writing task. [s1] [s6]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
2027 university-specific living stipend is not published in the checked international guide. BICMR's 2026-cycle
page quotes total package RMB 160,000-200,000/year INCLUDING CSC; it does not identify cash stipend versus
tuition/housing components and is not a 2027 guarantee. General 2027-28 full CSC standard, corroborated by
a Chinese embassy: doctoral living stipend RMB 3,500/month=42,000/year, master's
3,000/month=36,000/year, plus tuition, housing/subsidy and medical insurance. Whether the applicant's PKU
award adopts this standard must be confirmed. PKU scholarship amount and Beijing A stipend amount not
found. Current 2027 science tuition table says pending approval; do not carry forward old approximate
40,000/year. [s1] [s6] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s16]
Years of support [Standing rule]
International bachelor's-entry PhD normally 5 years; master's-entry 4 years. Standing CSC award supports 4-5
years and annual review. PKU scholarship standing page says 4 years PhD, creating a potential fifth-year gap
for direct entrants. Beijing Government Scholarship for new students follows standard programme duration;
current-student awards last one year. BICMR's 2027 package duration/guarantee is not verified. [s1] [s6] [s11]
[s12] [s13]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
The listed CSC, PKU and Beijing awards are expressly for eligible international students. Initial application is
labelled self-funded even when subsequently seeking scholarships. Admission does not itself guarantee an
award. Chinese-national applicants use a different domestic funding system; international scholarships cannot
be assumed. CSC general degree/age rules and direct-bachelor exception for PKU need confirmation;
Tsinghua's explicit exception cannot be transferred to PKU. [s1] [s10] [s11] [s12] [s13] [s16]
Conditions and duties [Conflict]
Awards require annual review; restrictions on concurrent scholarships apply (some one-time merit awards
excepted). PKU/CSC calls exclude joint-training candidates in the reviewed prior-cycle notice. Beijing
scholarship doctoral age limit 40 at entry and ordinary-tuition-programme condition apply. BICMR page's
CSC-housing language conflicts with its quoted discounted 130 RMB/day room rate; resolve housing coverage
in the written offer. TA/RA duties, net living allowance, taxes, insurance beyond awarded coverage and
fifth-year terms are not publicly quantified. [s6] [s10] [s11] [s12] [s13]
Extra funding application [Prior cycle]
Yes: scholarship application is separate from academic admission. Standing CSC process requires both PKU and
CSC submissions. In 2026 a single PKU scholarship form covered CSC/PKUS/Beijing consideration, but CSC
additionally required its own application, Type B institution code 10001, and specific pre-admission certificate.
Only one final scholarship was awarded.2027 form-opening dates/workflow must be confirmed. [s10] [s11] [s12]
[s13]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Embassy/dispatching-agency CSC Type A is a separate possible route, with nationality-specific deadlines.
BICMR institutional scholarship may supplement CSC within the stated total package; do not add the full
package and CSC twice. Continuing-student donation/merit awards appear in the official directory but are not
guaranteed initial funding. Chinese-national branch needs the domestic 2027 funding offer separately. [s6] [s16]
[s18]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
International: RMB 800 per major/programme, nonrefundable; online payment by 25 December 2026. Up to
two university applications may be possible, each paid separately, but older BICMR instructions limit its
applicant to one major; verify programme restriction. Chinese-national Math/BICMR: RMB 200, one choice, paid
by 25 December 2026 17:00. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s7]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
International route: a bachelor's holder may apply directly to science PhD programmes; the current
mathematics catalogue includes English-taught pure mathematics. A UChicago mathematics degree is
academically appropriate, subject to qualification assessment and completion before September 2027
registration. Applicant must qualify as non-Chinese; former mainland/Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan residents need
qualifying foreign nationality documents issued before 30 April 2021 plus evidence of Chinese-nationality
cancellation. The statement template excludes holders of Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan resident identity cards
from this international route. F-1 status does not resolve citizenship. Alternative if Chinese: 2027 Math/BICMR
accepts overseas bachelor's graduates from School-recognized world-class universities with GPA above 3.5/4.0
or top-50% class standing. Chinese-taught master's is also listed, with HSK requirements. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s7] [s8]

Choose the correct nationality route and specific research field. Arrange official transcripts,
expected-graduation proof, passport history, signed templates and two senior academic referees. Graduates
need CSCSE degree authentication when applying; final-year students may defer it until enrolment. Obtain
approval before treating UChicago English-medium study as alternative English evidence. International
admission is followed by academic screening and a second examination/interview January-March 2027; exact
mathematics arrangements are not yet published. Plan a separate scholarship application and later
paper-document delivery. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s7]

was identified for international admission; scholarship research-plan signature can make contact necessary
